```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# LOAD SUPERMARKET

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

# LOAD SHRINKAGE

shrinkage <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/shrinkage.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    items_expected = as.numeric(items_expected),
    revenue_expected = as.numeric(revenue_expected),
    items_registered = as.numeric(items_registered),
    revenue_registered = as.numeric(revenue_registered),
    items_lost = as.numeric(items_lost),
    revenue_lost = as.numeric(revenue_lost)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    item_loss_rate = items_lost / items_expected,
    revenue_loss_rate = revenue_lost / revenue_expected
  )

# optional combined department risk
shrinkage <- shrinkage %>%
  mutate(
    dept_shrinkage_score =
      0.5 * percent_rank(item_loss_rate) +
      0.5 * percent_rank(revenue_loss_rate)
  )

# ITEM-LEVEL SHRINKAGE ATTACHMENT

long_shrinkage <- long_data %>%
  left_join(
    shrinkage %>%
      select(
        department,
        item_loss_rate,
        revenue_loss_rate,
        dept_shrinkage_score
      ),
    by = "department"
  )

# BASKET-LEVEL SHRINKAGE FEATURES

basket_shrinkage <- long_shrinkage %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),

    avg_item_loss_rate = mean(item_loss_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_revenue_loss_rate = mean(revenue_loss_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_item_loss_rate = max(item_loss_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_revenue_loss_rate = max(revenue_loss_rate, na.rm = TRUE),

    avg_dept_shrinkage_score = mean(dept_shrinkage_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_dept_shrinkage_score = max(dept_shrinkage_score, na.rm = TRUE),

    value_weighted_shrinkage =
      sum(price * dept_shrinkage_score, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),

    high_shrinkage_item_share =
      mean(dept_shrinkage_score >= quantile(shrinkage$dept_shrinkage_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),

    high_shrinkage_value_share =
      sum(ifelse(
        dept_shrinkage_score >= quantile(shrinkage$dept_shrinkage_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        price,
        0
      ), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, 0)
  )

# FINAL SHRINKAGE SCORE

basket_shrinkage <- basket_shrinkage %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_score =
      0.15 * percent_rank(total_price) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(avg_price) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(avg_item_loss_rate) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(avg_revenue_loss_rate) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(max_item_loss_rate) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(max_revenue_loss_rate) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(value_weighted_shrinkage) +
      0.05 * percent_rank(high_shrinkage_item_share) +
      0.05 * percent_rank(high_shrinkage_value_share)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(shrinkage_score))

top_150_shrinkage_train <- basket_shrinkage %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_shrinkage_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_shrinkage_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_shrinkage_train$avg_dept_shrinkage_score)
summary(top_150_shrinkage_train$shrinkage_score)

write.csv(
  top_150_shrinkage_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_shrinkage_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

#CASE 19

# TRAIN: stocktake-informed score on supermarket

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

# LOAD STOCKTAKE MISSING

stocktake <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/stocktake_missing.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    item_value = as.numeric(item_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(item_value),
    item_value >= 0
  )

# DEPARTMENT-LEVEL STOCKTAKE PROFILE

stocktake_profile <- stocktake %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    missing_count = n(),
    missing_mean_value = mean(item_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_median_value = median(item_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_sd_value = sd(item_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_p75_value = quantile(item_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_p90_value = quantile(item_value, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_sd_value = replace_na(missing_sd_value, 0),
    dept_missing_score =
      0.5 * percent_rank(missing_count) +
      0.5 * percent_rank(missing_mean_value)
  )

# ITEM-LEVEL ATTACHMENT

long_stock <- long_data %>%
  left_join(stocktake_profile, by = "department") %>%
  mutate(
    missing_count = replace_na(missing_count, 0),
    missing_mean_value = replace_na(missing_mean_value, median(stocktake_profile$missing_mean_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    missing_median_value = replace_na(missing_median_value, median(stocktake_profile$missing_median_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    missing_sd_value = replace_na(missing_sd_value, median(stocktake_profile$missing_sd_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    missing_p75_value = replace_na(missing_p75_value, median(stocktake_profile$missing_p75_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    missing_p90_value = replace_na(missing_p90_value, median(stocktake_profile$missing_p90_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dept_missing_score = replace_na(dept_missing_score, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value_gap_to_missing_median = abs(price - missing_median_value),
    value_gap_to_missing_mean = abs(price - missing_mean_value),
    within_missing_p75 = price <= missing_p75_value,
    within_missing_p90 = price <= missing_p90_value
  )

# BASKET-LEVEL STOCKTAKE FEATURES

basket_stocktake <- long_stock %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),

    avg_missing_count = mean(missing_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_missing_mean_value = mean(missing_mean_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_missing_median_value = mean(missing_median_value, na.rm = TRUE),

    avg_dept_missing_score = mean(dept_missing_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_dept_missing_score = max(dept_missing_score, na.rm = TRUE),

    value_weighted_missing_score =
      sum(price * dept_missing_score, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),

    avg_value_gap_to_missing_median = mean(value_gap_to_missing_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_value_gap_to_missing_mean = mean(value_gap_to_missing_mean, na.rm = TRUE),

    share_items_within_missing_p75 = mean(within_missing_p75, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_items_within_missing_p90 = mean(within_missing_p90, na.rm = TRUE),

    high_missing_dept_item_share =
      mean(dept_missing_score >= quantile(stocktake_profile$dept_missing_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),

    high_missing_dept_value_share =
      sum(ifelse(
        dept_missing_score >= quantile(stocktake_profile$dept_missing_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        price,
        0
      ), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    high_missing_dept_value_share = replace_na(high_missing_dept_value_share, 0)
  )

# FINAL STOCKTAKE SCORE

basket_stocktake <- basket_stocktake %>%
  mutate(
    stocktake_score =
      0.15 * percent_rank(total_price) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(avg_price) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(avg_dept_missing_score) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(max_dept_missing_score) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(value_weighted_missing_score) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(share_items_within_missing_p75) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(share_items_within_missing_p90) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(high_missing_dept_item_share) +
      0.05 * percent_rank(high_missing_dept_value_share)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(stocktake_score))

top_150_stocktake_train <- basket_stocktake %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_stocktake_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_stocktake_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_stocktake_train$avg_dept_missing_score)
summary(top_150_stocktake_train$stocktake_score)

write.csv(
  top_150_stocktake_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_stocktake_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
